sloka: ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः सम्प्रधनो हरिः।अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तु महागजम् ।। ६.९७.१८ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pādapamuddhṛtya śūraḥ sampradhano hariḥ।abhipatya jaghānāsya pramukhe tu mahāgajam ।। 6.97.18 ।।

translations.english: Then springing up, the valiant Vanara uprooting a tree struck the face of the Rakshasa seated on the great elephant.
